Virginia Donohue, Camp Director at Pet Camp, plays with her two dogs in the exercise yard beneath the solar-electric panels on the roof of the facilities. Pet Camp is a kennel facility that has one of the Bay Area's biggest solar-electric power installations. The rooftop solar panels are a 33-kilowatt system that powers the facilities, which houses hundreds of dogs and cats a week. The owners, husband and wife, Virginia Donohue and Mark Klaiman -- are thrilled over the system, which they installed more than 2 years ago and which Klaiman estimates is almost halfway to paying off its installation costs. Every 3 months they clean it off with a garden hose.
